meta_descripcion: A studio building tailor-made apps for local businesses, town festivals and health. Create, add, improve.
portada_titulo: Software that takes work away, not software that adds it.
portada_entradilla: We design and build tailor-made applications for small and mid-sized businesses: just enough to solve the problem, working from day one, without forcing anyone to change how they work.
lineas_titulo: One studio, any kind of job.
lineas_entradilla: Each line has its own name and colour, built around the 4 in our brand. Behind them there is a single way of working.
como_entradilla: The brand claim is literally the method: publish something small that already helps, then grow on top of something that is alive.

pasos.texto: We start with the smallest version that genuinely solves the problem. No months of project work before you see anything running.
What comes next is driven by real use, not by a list written before we started. You pay for what you use.
The application stays alive: it gets fixed, refined and adapted to whatever the business needs later on.

llamada_texto: Tell us in four lines. If it is not for us, we will say so.

verticales.resumen: Tools for the daily grind of a business: capturing documents, sorting orders, and no longer chasing paperwork by email.
verticales.hero_texto: A shop or a small practice does not need a huge management system. It needs the one specific task that eats an hour a day to stop eating it. That is what we build.

que.texto: A photo replaces manual data entry. The document arrives already identified and filed, in front of whoever has to deal with it.
Web applications that open from a link. No app store, no updates, no training anyone.
The application adapts to your accounting software and your mail, not the other way round.

verticales.muestras_entradilla: Real work. Client names only appear with their permission.

muestras.titulo: Receipt capture for an accounting firm
muestras.texto: The firm's clients photograph their receipts on their phone and they reach the accounting inbox already stamped with the company name and tax number, ready for the accounting software to identify on its own. Nothing to install: one link per person.
muestras.detalle: Web app · Server-side PDF · Bilingual · Automatic mail delivery

muestras.texto: If there is a repetitive task eating time every day in your business, it can probably be taken out of the way. Tell us about it and we will say whether it can be fixed and what it would cost.

verticales.resumen: The programme, announcements and audience participation in every attendee's pocket, with nothing to install.
verticales.hero_texto: A paper programme gets lost, gets wet, and cannot be corrected when it rains and an event moves. A festival app solves that and, along the way, lets the organisers see what is actually working.

que.texto: If an event changes time or venue, it changes on everybody's phone straight away.
A notice reaches the people who are out on the street right then, which is when it is worth anything.
It opens from a link or a QR code on the poster. Anyone who wants to can save it to their home screen.

verticales.muestras_entradilla: This line is just starting. Work will appear here as it gets done.

muestras.texto: Day-by-day programme, favourites, announcements from the organisers and a map of the events. Designed so the town council or the festival committee can run it without knowing anything about computers.
muestras.detalle: Web app · Editing panel for organisers

muestras.texto: If you are on a festival committee or at a town council and this year's programme is still a PDF, let's talk before the season starts.

verticales.resumen: Our own product. Applications born here, with no client behind them, because the problem seemed worth solving.
verticales.hero_titulo: Small things, kept up over time.
verticales.hero_texto: This is the own-product line: applications nobody commissioned. The first one is about habits, because almost everything to do with health comes down to repeating small things on many consecutive days.

que.texto: No endless lists, no point systems. What actually sustains a habit is seeing it, ticking it, and not breaking the streak.
No compulsory accounts, no profiles to sell. What you record stays on your phone unless you decide otherwise.
The goal is ten seconds a day. A habit app that keeps you inside it is a habit app that has failed.

verticales.muestras_entradilla: Product in development. It will show up here as soon as there is something to try.

muestras.texto: Daily habit logging with streaks, reminders and a month view you can read at a glance. No advertising and no compulsory account.
muestras.detalle: Mobile app · Works offline · First version in preparation

muestras.texto: The health line is open: medication reminders, tracking vital signs, notebooks to take to appointments. If you miss something that does not exist, or exists badly, tell us.

verticales.resumen: None yet. It is here because the studio is called apps4all, and that includes what we have not built yet.
verticales.hero_texto: And we say so on the front page instead of hiding it. This line exists because the studio is called apps4all: any kind of job, not a closed list of three. If a game ever comes along, its place is already made.

que.texto: apps4all reads as "apps for all". Closing the catalogue at three categories would contradict the name on the very first screen.

que.titulo: We know what we do not know
que.texto: We have never built a game and we are not going to pretend otherwise. If you commission one, the first thing you will hear is which part we are not fluent in.
The same goes for anything else that does not fit the three lines next door. Ask, and we will tell you honestly whether it is for us.

verticales.muestras_entradilla: None so far. This page is a statement of intent, not a portfolio.

muestras.titulo: The first one, when it comes
muestras.texto: Once there is a game, or any job that does not fit the other lines, it will show up here with what was built and what it cost.
muestras.detalle: No work on this line yet

muestras.texto: If what you have in mind looks like nothing else on this site, this is your section. Tell us: the worst that can happen is that we say no.
